24-08-2026 Dhaval
ALTER TABLE `contact_masters` ADD COLUMN `position` INT NULL AFTER `contact_status`;
UPDATE contact_masters cm
JOIN (
  SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY contact_status ORDER BY id) * 1000 AS rn
  FROM contact_masters
) t ON cm.id = t.id
SET cm.position = t.rn;

ALTER TABLE `task_managements` ADD COLUMN `position` INT NULL AFTER `status`;
UPDATE task_managements tm
JOIN (
  SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY id) * 1000 AS rn
  FROM task_managements
) t ON tm.id = t.id
SET tm.position = t.rn;

21-08-2026 Dhaval
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `stock_ledger_view` AS
SELECT
  ci.id,
  ci.company_masters_id,
  ci.item_product_id,
  ci.cart_type,
  ci.reference_type,
  ci.cart_date,
  ci.item_qty,
  ci.stock_type,
  ci.item_warehouse_id,
  ci.a_application_login_id,
  0 AS isDelete,
  CASE
    WHEN (ci.cart_type = 4 AND ci.reference_type != 8) OR ci.cart_type IN (6,8,10) THEN ci.item_qty
    WHEN (ci.cart_type = 3 AND ci.reference_type != 9) OR ci.cart_type IN (7,9,11) THEN -ci.item_qty
    ELSE 0
  END AS qty_delta
FROM `cart_items` ci
WHERE ci.isDelete = 0
  AND ci.cart_number IS NOT NULL AND ci.cart_number != ''
  AND (
    (ci.cart_type = 4 AND ci.reference_type != 8)
    OR (ci.cart_type = 3 AND ci.reference_type != 9)
    OR ci.cart_type IN (6,7,8,9,10,11)
  );

21-08-2026 Dhaval
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `account_outstanding_view` AS
SELECT
  at.id,
  at.company_masters_id,
  at.contact_masters_id,
  at.a_application_login_id,
  at.type,
  at.mode,
  at.amount,
  at.payment_date_time,
  at.approve_date_time,
  at.remark,
  0 AS isDelete,
  CASE
    WHEN at.type = 2 THEN at.amount
    WHEN at.type = 1 THEN -at.amount
    ELSE 0
  END AS amount_signed
FROM `account_transactions` at
WHERE at.isDelete = 0
  AND at.approve_by_a_application_login_id != 0;

CREATE TABLE `event_type_masters` (
  `id` INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `event_type_name` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `event_type_color` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  `created_date_time` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `modified_date` DATETIME NULL,
  `s_timestemp` DATETIME NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `isActive` TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `isDelete` TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
);
CREATE TABLE `event_masters` (
  `id` INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `event_type_id` INT(11) NOT NULL,
  `event_title` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  `event_date` DATE NOT NULL,
  `is_participation_allowed` TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `created_date_time` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `modified_date` DATETIME NULL,
  `s_timestemp` DATETIME NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `isActive` TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `isDelete` TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `event_masters_event_type_id` (`event_type_id`)
);
CREATE TABLE `event_participant_masters` (
  `id` INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `event_id` INT(11) NULL,
  `participant_name` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  `participant_email` VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  `participant_whatsapp_no` VARCHAR(20) NULL,
  `participant_company_name` VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  `created_date_time` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `modified_date` DATETIME NULL,
  `s_timestemp` DATETIME NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `isActive` TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `isDelete` TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `event_participant_masters_event_id` (`event_id`)
);

ALTER TABLE `inquiries` ADD `product_remarks` LONGTEXT NULL DEFAULT NULL AFTER `qty`;
-- Per-product remarks for the multi-product inquiry rows. Positionally
-- paired with the comma-joined product_id/qty/category_id - free text
-- (commas/newlines) so it cannot use their comma-join; joined instead with
-- the distinctive delimiter "||$||" ("remark 1||$||remark 2"). Also apply
-- to smalloffice_sample_tenant.
-- migration: migration/tenant/migrations/20260830130000-add-product-remarks-to-inquiries.js
